name: Gyoubu Souta
source:
[i]"Now that we're all in this together, we have to cooperate to get over this. Isn't that right?"[/i]

Supposedly attends Gekkei High School like the protagonist, but she's never seen him there. He's an eccentric man who always acts aloof. He loves old games. 

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/chara/?page=ch7]Idea Factory International[/url]]
